rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the feeling of frustration when resistance or failure prevents you achieving something.

example.english: I feel a lot of frustration after working on this for so long without success.
example.traditional: 整咗咁耐都未成功，真係好有挫折感。
example.jyutping: zing2 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 mei6 sing4 gung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 co3 zit3 gam2
